case_scope: United States energy/water utility burden, arrears, and disconnection

place_public_finance_gate.note: Residential utility disconnections and high low-income energy burdens make essential-service access an active floor interruption, not just a billing issue.

utility_affordability_burden.note: Energy burden and final-notice/disconnection data must be read at household threshold moments and by utility geography.

utility_disconnection_protection.note: The EIA disconnection dataset makes the shutoff problem nationally visible, but medical, weather, restoration, and state protection details remain proof debt.

water_wastewater_need_pressure.note: Water assistance and infrastructure need must be tested by prevention/restoration of service and household rate incidence, not only program dollars or capital estimates.

intergovernmental_transfer_reliability.note: Water/energy assistance remains a conversion-rail risk because funds, direct payment, timing, and eligibility may not arrive before shutoff.

proof_debt: arrears and final notices by geography
assistance take-up, direct payment, and timeliness

gate_15_place_public_finance.why: Gate 15 is blocked: utility burden and disconnection evidence shows essential public-service access can fail before assistance or repairs convert.

evidence_debt_register.question: disconnections by utility and subgroup
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Use utility-level EIA disconnection data and subgroup overlays to identify where essential service interruption concentrates.

evidence_debt_register.question: arrears and final notices by geography
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track final notices, arrears, shutoff notices, and payment plans by utility, locality, income, age, disability, and renter/homeowner status.

evidence_debt_register.question: water-shutoff data and affordability rates
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Add water shutoff, arrears, rate design, LIHWAP experience, and water-infrastructure cost pass-through data.

evidence_debt_register.question: reconnection timing and fees
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure days to reconnection, fees, deposits, prepayment requirements, collections, and credit-reporting transition after service loss.

evidence_debt_register.question: medical vulnerability and extreme-weather protections
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Audit state/utility medical, heat, cold, disability, and senior-protection exceptions for automatic coverage and speed.

evidence_debt_register.question: assistance take-up, direct payment, and timeliness
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Verify whether assistance funds reach utilities before final notices mature into shutoffs and whether benefits are enough for full restoration.

validation_notes: rev0335 removed stale place_public_finance_gate_seed calibration label; active scoring now requires source-backed service-floor, fiscal-capacity, and threshold-moment evidence.
